openai/gpt-5-mini.mistake:
Minor pragmatic mismatches (not formal errors):
- Two NL phrases use modal/epistemic language: “then they can create innovative art” and “she is likely to explore unconventional ideas.” The FOL implications assert p_7 and p_6 categorically rather than modal/ probabilistic claims. 
- The universal quantifier ∀x in the two axioms assumes an appropriate domain (NL says “for all humans”); the formula omits an explicit domain restriction (tolerable if domain is intended to be humans). 
- The simple disjunction p_9 ∨ p_11 corresponds to the NL “or,” which is ambiguous in natural language between inclusive/exclusive; here it is represented as inclusive ∨ — acceptable but worth noting.
These are pragmatic/interpretation issues rather than mismatches of predicate mapping.
